import { liveQuery, type LiveQuery, type LiveQueryOptions, type LiveQuerySubscriptionCallbacks } from 'turbine-orm/live-query';
import type { TurbineClient } from 'turbine-orm';

function equal<T>(_value: T): void {}
const subscribe: LiveQueryOptions<unknown>['subscribe'] = (_invalidate, _callbacks) => ({ unsubscribe() {} });
const primitive = liveQuery({ subscribe, query: () => ({ id: 7, name: 'typed' }) });
equal<LiveQuery<{ id: number; name: string }>>(primitive);
const tuple = liveQuery({ subscribe, query: async () => [1, 'x'] as const });
equal<LiveQuery<readonly [1, 'x']>>(tuple);
const nullable = liveQuery({ subscribe, query: (): Promise<{ id: bigint } | null> => Promise.resolve(null) });
equal<LiveQuery<{ id: bigint } | null>>(nullable);
// @ts-expect-error query result must not become any or lose its field type
equal<LiveQuery<{ id: string }>>(primitive);

function ordinaryTypedQuery(db: TurbineClient) {
  const query = () => db.table<{ id: number; name: string; secret: string }>('users').findMany({
    select: { id: true, name: true }, orderBy: { id: 'asc' },
  });
  const live = liveQuery({ query, subscribe: (invalidate, { onReconnect }) => db.$listen('users_changed', invalidate, { onReconnect }) });
  equal<LiveQuery<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof query>>>>(live);
  live.next().then((result) => {
    if (!result.done) {
      equal<number>(result.value[0]!.id);
      equal<string>(result.value[0]!.name);
      // @ts-expect-error projection must omit secret
      result.value[0]!.secret;
      // @ts-expect-error selected field must not become any
      equal<string>(result.value[0]!.id);
    }
  });
  return live;
}
void ordinaryTypedQuery;
void (null as unknown as LiveQuerySubscriptionCallbacks);

async function run() {
  let invalidate!: () => void;
  let unsubscribe = 0;
  let value = 1;
  const live = liveQuery({
    query: () => ({ value }),
    subscribe: (handler) => { invalidate = handler; return { unsubscribe() { unsubscribe++; } }; },
  });
  const first = await live.next();
  if (first.done || first.value.value !== 1) throw new Error('first snapshot mismatch');
  value = 9;
  invalidate();
  const next = await live.next();
  if (next.done || next.value.value !== 9) throw new Error('refetch mismatch');
  await live.dispose();
  if (unsubscribe !== 1) throw new Error('listener cleanup mismatch');
  await Promise.all([primitive.dispose(), tuple.dispose(), nullable.dispose()]);
  console.log('strict consumer: exact types, rows and cleanup passed');
}
run().catch((error) => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; });
